notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.111

• Lock screen: swiping up on Android's bar at the bottom no longer leaves you on Android's old lock screen — DuckOS's lock screen comes straight back (and with it, changing the lock screen only happens in DuckOS's own gallery: hold the lock screen).
• Home screen: moving an app is smooth — it settles into its new place from where you let go, instead of jumping back and sliding over.
• Texts written on DuckCloud's website (cloud.ducktask.xyz/messages) go out from your phone within seconds, also with the phone in your pocket (on Wi-Fi, or whenever the screen is on).
• Scanning DuckCloud's QR code with the Camera opens the right card in DuckConnections, even when Settings was already open.
• "Open your messages there" is properly translated (German, Turkish).
• Removing an app: its icon shrinks away before it goes.
